common: Candid documentary photograph, vertical 9:16, a frame from a mockumentary TV comedy shot in a real, lived-in Indian government office. Exactly the same man, the same outfit (faded navy-blue cotton half-sleeve shirt, top button undone, loosened maroon tie, steel wristwatch, blue pen in the pocket), the same room and the same light as the reference image: cool overhead tubelight mixing with warm late-afternoon sun through the barred window on camera left. Skin with visible pores, faint oil on forehead and nose, slight under-eye darkness, uneven stubble shadow; the cotton shirt in soft irregular folds; the tie with a faint sheen. Natural colour, fine grain, a real photograph, not glossy, no CGI, no plastic skin. No new text.
C1: Chest-up medium close-up, straight on, eye level, about 1 m away, 50 mm lens at f/2.8, handheld documentary framing slightly off-centre. His head and shoulders fill the frame, face about a quarter of the frame height, centred horizontally, the top of the frame just above his hair. He looks straight into the lens, head level, caught between two words: brows pulled together in exasperated disbelief, one eyebrow slightly higher, lips closed, annoyed and tired, not smiling. Behind him, softer: the peeling pale-green wall and the lower edge of the blue enamel board. Foreground: nothing.
C2: Chest-up three-quarter view from the camera's left, eye level, about 1.2 m away, 50 mm lens at f/2.8: his body turned slightly to screen-right, head turned back so his eyes look straight into the lens, head level. Face about a quarter of the frame height. Brows knitted, eyes narrowed in disbelief, lips closed. Behind him, out of focus: the barred window glowing with warm sun on the left and the pale-green wall. In the near foreground at the left edge, a blurred grey steel almirah edge partly in frame, as if the camera peeks past it.
C3: Low angle from just above the desk edge, about 1 m away, 35 mm lens at f/4, looking slightly up at him: chest-up, head level, eyes looking down into the lens, face about a quarter of the frame height. Above him: the ceiling fan, the tubelight and cracked, flaking plaster at the top of the pale-green wall. Brows raised in incredulous annoyance, lips closed. The warm window light grazes the left side of his face.
C4: Chest-up three-quarter view from the camera's right, eye level, about 1.2 m away, 50 mm lens at f/2.8: his body turned slightly to screen-left, head turned back toward the lens, eyes straight into the lens, head level, face about a quarter of the frame height. A dry, fed-up stare, one corner of the mouth pulled in, lips closed. Behind him, out of focus: the wall calendar and the warm patch of sun on the pale-green wall. In the near foreground at the bottom-right, a blurred stack of old files tied with faded red cloth tape.
B1: Close-up at desk level of the real ginger desi street cat from the reference (ginger tabby, heavy belly, coarse dusty coat, notched left ear, scarred nose) sitting upright on the worn wooden desk, facing the camera, calm, eyes half-closed. 85 mm lens at f/2.8, eye level with the cat. Behind it, out of focus: the man's navy shirt and maroon tie, the pale-green wall, warm window light from the left rimming the cat's fur. A real candid photograph, natural cat, not a studio shot, not plush.
